Full summary: Wrote and pushed the next-session handoff (docs/plans/2026-09-15-foundation-handoff.md, commit 9b0afafd on foundation/v3; origin now current). Session ends with all five lanes merged, 2711 tests green, PRs #48/#49 open, remaining work = dev-scale trial + final report + operator docs.
Decisions: Chose a dedicated handoff document (reading order, branch/PR table, remaining work in order, owner items, standing rules) over relying on the log + memory alone — the log is an append-only audit trail and memory is a pointer; a fresh session needs one page that says what to do first.
Findings: The earlier push failures ('Could not read from remote repository') were transient — the SSH agent recovered; foundation/v3 is pushed through 9b0afafd. Next session: twining_assemble on src/, read the handoff, then run the matched trial (RB5) under Max auth before writing docs/reports/2026-09-foundation-final.md.
